newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA'S NET FOREIGN RESERVES DROP TO $10.25 BLN.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA'S NET FOREIGN RESERVES DROP TO $10.25 BLN.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves fell $25.5 million to $10.25 billion as of July 25, the last date for which official figures are available, the central bank said Monday.
In the year to July 25, Colombia's net foreign reserves have increased 3.7 percent or $362.9 million compared with the end of last year.
Gross foreign reserves have grown 4.8 percent, or $473.4 million, in the year so far and stood at $10.41 billion as of July 25.
